integrity_statement: Definitions, boundary cases, all-degree proof and supplementary reproducible polynomial checker are included. No independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the second-gap monic probabilists Hermite mixture with real coefficient and degree at least two is classified. Asymptotic constants may depend on fixed degree. No independent mathematical audit has been conducted.
title: Sharp parity-dependent real-zero threshold and escape law for two-gap Hermite mixtures
